name: Alicia
source:
Alicia is a priestess from Toushin City born on the floating island of Ylapu. She's the younger twin sister of [url=/c97639]Cynthia[/url], and the two are part of the small Younashi Church that formed on the Toushin Toshi. 

Alicia is nowhere near as devoted as Cynthia is to the God Younashi and her sister considers her a delinquent. The two don't get along well but they still seem to hold some affection for the other.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Kiseda_Espira]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
